trace.final_message:
The rounding module is added and committed as `50c55e6`. All 38 tests pass under `make check`, 13 of them new, and `make lint` is clean.

**What was added**
- `hourglass/rounding.py` has three public functions:
  - `round_span(span, step)` rounds the start and end of a span to the nearest step. Halves round up, so 08:53 with a 15-minute step becomes 09:00.
  - `span_label(span)` returns text such as `09:00-17:15 (8h 15m)`. A 30-minute span reads `0h 30m`.
  - `round_labels(spans, step)` rounds each span and returns one label per span.
- A step that is zero, negative or does not divide 60 raises `ValueError`. That includes 7, 45 and 90. `round_labels` checks the step first, so an empty list with a bad step still raises.
- `tests/test_rounding.py` covers nearest and half-up rounding, edges that are already on a step, the end of the day, bad and good steps, and the label format.
- `docs/api.txt` and `CHANGES.txt` have entries for the new functions.

**Collapsing spans**
If rounding makes a span empty, for example 01:01-01:04 with a 15-minute step, `round_span` raises `ValueError`. That comes from the existing `Span` validation. I did not decide on a different behavior, such as dropping the span or widening it to one step. Payroll may want one of those instead.

**Not changed**
I did not add the new functions to the exports in `hourglass/__init__.py`. They are imported from `hourglass.rounding`.

The new Python files follow the project conventions in `CLAUDE.md`.

before.CHANGES.txt:
## Unreleased
- Clearer wording when a span ends before it starts.

## 0.7.1 (2026-07-08)
- normalize_day accepts full day names in any case.

## 0.7.0 (2026-04-22)
- Add format_day_line and day_coverage.
- worker_minutes no longer merges overlaps for the same worker.

## 0.6.0 (2025-12-15)
- Read schedules from CSV.

## 0.5.0 (2025-09-30)
- Add intersect_spans. Touching spans no longer count as overlapping.
before.docs/api.txt:
hourglass.parsing.parse_clock(text): read a clock time as minutes since midnight
hourglass.parsing.format_clock(minutes): minutes since midnight as HH:MM
hourglass.parsing.parse_span(text): read a range such as 09:00-17:30
hourglass.parsing.format_span(span): a span as start-end text
hourglass.parsing.normalize_day(text): short lowercase day name
hourglass.merging.spans_overlap(first, second): whether two spans share any time
hourglass.merging.intersect_spans(first, second): the part two spans share
hourglass.merging.merge_spans(spans): collapse overlaps into a sorted list
hourglass.merging.total_minutes(spans): minutes covered, overlaps counted once
hourglass.schedule.parse_schedule_text(text): parse schedule CSV held in memory
hourglass.schedule.load_schedule(path): read a schedule CSV from disk
hourglass.schedule.shifts_for_worker(shifts, worker): all shifts for one worker
hourglass.schedule.worker_minutes(shifts): scheduled minutes per worker
hourglass.schedule.day_coverage(shifts, day): merged spans for a day
hourglass.schedule.format_day_line(shifts, day): one text line for a day
